title: Local C^∞ extensions glue to a C^∞ extension on an open neighbourhood (smooth partition of unity, parent step 6)
statement: Gluing local smooth extensions. Data: P ∈ ℕ; a real normed space F; M ⊆ ℝ^P; f : ℝ^P → F. Hypothesis: every y ∈ M has an open set O_y ∋ y and a map g_y : ℝ^P → F that is C^∞ on O_y (ContDiffOn ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g_y O_y) with g_y(z) = f(z) for every z ∈ M ∩ O_y. Conclusion: there are ν : ℝ^P → F and an open set O ⊆ ℝ^P with M ⊆ O such that ν is C^∞ on O and ν(x) = f(x) for every x ∈ M.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (F : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (M : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → F), (∀ y ∈ M, ∃ (O : Set (Euclid P)) (g : Euclid P → F), IsOpen O ∧ y ∈ O ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g O ∧ ∀ z ∈ M ∩ O, g z = f z) → ∃ (ν : Euclid P → F) (O : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen O ∧ M ⊆ O ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ν O ∧ ∀ x ∈ M, ν x = f x
